questions.q: What is the fundamental check performed by a Trial Balance report?
options: That every supplier has been paid
That total debits equal total credits across the accounts included
That the Balance Sheet is formatted correctly
That OTBI subject area access is configured properly
questions.explain: The Trial Balance's core purpose is confirming total debits equal total credits, directly reflecting double-entry bookkeeping.

questions.q: What does it mean if a Trial Balance's total debits do not equal its total credits?
options: This is normal and expected every period
Something in the underlying journals or balance summarization is wrong and needs to be resolved before trusting downstream statements
The report simply needs to be reformatted
It means the Balance Sheet is automatically correct regardless
questions.explain: An out-of-balance Trial Balance signals a real problem that must be investigated and corrected before the Income Statement or Balance Sheet can be trusted.

questions.q: What does an Account Analysis report show that a Trial Balance does not?
options: A summary of every account's balance side by side
Every transaction or journal line that moved a specific account's balance during the period
The company's full Balance Sheet
A list of unpaid supplier invoices
questions.explain: Account Analysis drills into one account's full detail, the transaction-level view a Trial Balance deliberately omits.

questions.q: In a typical close sequence, which report is pulled first to confirm things balance overall, before investigating any specific issue?
options: Account Analysis
The Balance Sheet
The Trial Balance
A Payables Aging report
questions.explain: The Trial Balance is the overall check run first; Account Analysis is used afterward to investigate anything that looks off.

questions.q: Why is a Trial Balance typically described as a "working document" rather than something handed to an external reader?
options: Because it cannot be exported from Oracle Fusion
Because it lists every account individually rather than summarizing into statement-level totals like "Total Revenue"
Because it contains no numeric data at all
Because only OTBI can produce it
questions.explain: Unlike the Income Statement's summarized totals, the Trial Balance's full account-by-account detail is primarily useful to the accounting team itself.
